testName: Qualify Lead and Convert to Account, Contact and Opportunity
steps:
1. Open Leads tab
2. Open record "Recent"
3. Click on Convert button in Lightning header
4. Select "Create New Account"
5. Select "Create New Opportunity" and enter "Apex Cloud - Enterprise License" in Opportunity Name
6. Select "Closed - Converted" from Converted Status
7. Click on Convert button in modal
8. Verify success modal "Your lead has been converted"
9. Click on Go to Opportunity button
10. Verify Opportunity details page is opened
